Client Success Story

How GrowthSpree Scaled BetterPlaces Pipeline with Multi-Channel Paid Ads

The Mission

BetterPlace is a workforce management platform built for the industries that run on large, distributed, frontline teams construction, logistics, and retail. Its mission is to digitize the entire workforce lifecycle, from hiring and onboarding through attendance, payroll, and benefits, so that businesses managing thousands of workers can do it with speed, compliance, and transparency.

The Challenge

For a workforce platform selling into enterprise and mid-market accounts, a predictable flow of qualified pipeline is non-negotiable. BetterPlace partnered with GrowthSpree to take full ownership of its paid advertising across Google, LinkedIn, and Meta with a clear mandate: grow marketing-qualified leads, move them efficiently down the funnel, and bring cost per lead under control.

Key Challenges Identified

  • Volatile cost per lead: LinkedIn CPL was running extremely high early in the engagement.
  • Weak MQL SQL conversion: rising lead volume wasnt translating into qualified pipeline efficiently.
  • Multi-platform coordination: Google, LinkedIn, and Meta needed distinct, channel-specific roles.
  • Scale without inflating cost: more MQLs were needed but not at any price.

Baseline: Where BetterPlace Started

Baseline snapshot before the multi-channel paid program

  • Spend / channels: Google, LinkedIn, and Meta were running without distinct, coordinated roles, so spend overlapped instead of specializing.
  • CAC / cost per lead: LinkedIn cost per lead was running extremely high early in the engagement, inflating overall acquisition cost.
  • Conversion rate: Rising MQL volume wasnt converting efficiently into qualified pipeline a weak MQL-to-SQL handoff.
  • Tracking issues: Attribution had to be rebuilt with clean conversion tracking across all three platforms, so decisions could follow pipeline quality rather than vanity metrics.

Our Strategy

We treated each channel as a specialist, not a duplicate. Google would carry high-intent, bottom-of-funnel demand and protect SQL quality. LinkedIn would target BetterPlaces ICP and scale MQL volume through stronger creative. Meta would drive cost-efficient reach and top-of-funnel volume. Underpinning all of it: tight tracking and a relentless focus on lead quality, not just lead count.

The GrowthSpree Approach

GrowthSpree took over BetterPlaces full paid stack across Google, LinkedIn, and Meta. We rebuilt targeting around high-intent and competitor keywords on Google, refined audiences and creative on LinkedIn including testimonial-video creative that lifted performance and used interest-based targeting on Meta to unlock low-cost volume.

Every channel was instrumented for clean attribution through GA and GTM events, heatmap tracking, and pixel integration so optimization decisions were driven by qualified-pipeline signals, not vanity metrics.

Campaigns

Each channel a specialist: Google for high-intent BOFU demand and SQLs, LinkedIn for ICP-targeted MQL volume, Meta for cost-efficient top-of-funnel reach.

Bidding budget

Concentrated spend where each channel was strongest high-intent and competitor keywords on Google, and interest-based Meta campaigns to unlock low-cost volume.

Landing pages creative

New creative including testimonial videos on LinkedIn, plus tighter lead qualification to turn rising MQL volume into sales-ready pipeline.

Tracking

GA and GTM events, heatmap tracking, and pixel integration for clean attribution so every MQL, SQL, and SAL traced back to source.

How GrowthSpree Saved the Day

Google Ads

Google carried bottom-of-funnel demand. We focused on high-intent and competitor keywords to capture buyers actively evaluating workforce platforms making Google the most consistent source of sales-qualified leads across the quarter.

  • Deep experience with LLM integration: prompt engineering, function/tool calling, RAG architecture, agent orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modeling, distributed systems, and production operations.

  • Track record of leading technical initiatives that span multiple teams or systems, with strong written communication (RFCs, design docs, ADRs).

  • Demonstrated ability to work with ambiguity - translating broad product goals into concrete technical plans and shipping iteratively.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strongly preferred: Hands-on experience building MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or production integrations. Stavtar runs MCP-first agentic infrastructure, and this experience is one of the most differentiating signals for this role.

  • Experience with at least one modern AI/agent framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Anthropic tool use, OpenAI Assistants, or similar) and a clear-eyed view of their trade-offs.

  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases.

  • Domain experience in FinTech, payments, accounting automation, fund administration, or financial operations.

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and a philosophy for how they change engineering workflows.

  • Background in building trust and safety systems for AI: content filtering, output validation, human-in-the-loop patterns, and audit logging for autonomous actions.

  • Experience with Azure cloud services, SQL Server, or Azure DevOps.

  • Familiarity with financial data formats and integrations: NACHA, ISO 20022, SWIFT, or accounting system APIs (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage).

  • Prior experience at a Staff/Principal level or as a founding/early engineer at a startup where you shaped technical direction.

What You Might Ship in the First Year

The specifics will depend on where you see the highest leverage, but examples of the kind of work we envision:

  • Agentic AP assistant - an AI agent that can process incoming invoices, match them to POs, and contracts, route for approval, flag anomalies, and draft payment instructions with human confirmation.

  • Agentic Contract assistant - an AI agent that can process incoming contracts, extract key terms and obligations as structured metadata, and route for human-in-the-loop review.

  • Natural-language financial queries - a conversational interface that lets controllers ask questions about payables, cash positions, and vendor history without building reports.

  • MCP integration layer - Build/Enhance MCP servers that expose StavPay s core capabilities to external AI tools, enabling clients to interact with StavPay from Claude, Copilot, or their own agentic systems.

  • Intelligent onboarding - AI-powered data extraction and mapping that accelerates client onboarding from weeks to days.

  • Evaluation and monitoring infrastructure - automated testing, quality scoring, and production observability for every AI-driven feature.

How We Measure Success

  1. Shipped AI features that clients actively use and that measurably reduce manual work in financial operations workflows.

  2. Reliable agentic systems - autonomous workflows that operate safely within defined guardrails, with low error rates and clear audit trails.

  3. Engineering velocity - the team ships AI features faster over time because of the infrastructure, patterns, and tooling you establish.

  4. Technical credibility - you are the person engineering, product, and leadership turn to for AI/agentic technical decisions, and your judgment is consistently sound.

  5. Team capability growth - engineers across the team are more effective at building AI-powered features because of your mentorship and the standards you set.

Why This Role Matters

Financial operations is one of the highest-value domains for AI, it is structured, repetitive, high-stakes, and ripe for intelligent automation. But building AI for finance requires more than model access. It requires deep product thinking, rigorous engineering, and respect for the fact that these systems move real money.

This role is the technical cornerstone of StavPay s AI strategy. You will not be bolting AI onto an existing product - you will be fundamentally reshaping how the product works, and how our clients work, by bringing agentic intelligence into every layer of financial operations.

If you want to build AI systems that matter, at a company where you can see the direct impact of your work on real businesses, this is the role.

title: Full Stack Engineer, AI Platform
jobDescription:
Accrete is a dynamic and innovative company focused on transforming the future of artificial intelligence. We specialize in creating advanced AI solutions that turn complex data into actionable insights, driving real-world impact for businesses and government organizations. Our team thrives on creativity and collaboration, working together to push the boundaries of AI technology.

At the core of our offerings are our AI agents, designed to autonomously analyze data, generate insights, and make intelligent recommendations. These agents help businesses streamline operations, improve decision-making, and also empower government entities to enhance security, intelligence, and operational efficiency

The Role

We are seeking a Full-Stack Engineer to join our AI Platform team. This team is responsible for building the core infrastructure, tools, and user-facing applications that enable development, deployment, and scaling of advanced AI systems. You will work across the stack to deliver performant, intuitive, and reliable systems that bridge complex AI capabilities with real-world user needs.

What You ll Do

  • Design and build end-to-end features across frontend and backend systems
  • Develop scalable APIs and services that power AI-driven applications
  • Build intuitive user interfaces for interacting with AI models and data
  • Collaborate closely with ML engineers to integrate models into production systems
  • Improve platform reliability, performance, and developer experience
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical direction of the AI platform
  • Own projects from concept through deployment and iteration

What We re Looking For

  • 3-5 years of experience in full-stack software engineering
  • Strong experience with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, TypeScript)
  • Backend experience with Python, Go, or similar languages
  • Experience building and consuming APIs (REST, GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Experience with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Strong product mindset with the ability to translate requirements into technical solutions
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, evolving environments

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with AI/ML systems or data-intensive applications
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with real-time systems or streaming architectures
  • Exposure to security, compliance, or government-focused environments

Core Values Expectations:

Impact

You take full ownership and accountability for your work, consistently seeing projects through from inception to completion with a strong bias for action. Proactively identifying challenges, you drive solutions rather than waiting for direction, and hold yourself and others to the highest standards for delivering results. With strategic thinking and a problem-solving mindset, you make informed decisions leveraging data and expertise, always looking for ways to improve processes, optimize workflows, and enhance outcomes beyond your immediate responsibilities.

Collaboration

You work seamlessly across teams, prioritizing shared goals and team success over individual credit. Engaged listening and open, candid communication are at the heart of your approach, ensuring alignment and synergy throughout the organization. You value diverse perspectives, seeking input from others to drive better results. By treating colleagues with respect and professionalism, you help build a culture of trust, supporting each other through challenges, celebrating successes, and constructively addressing conflicts to strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

Passion for AI Innovation

You are deeply excited about the transformative potential of AI and committed to contributing to a company shaping the future of work. With curiosity and a growth mindset, you continuously seek to learn, adapt, and stay at the forefront of new developments. Your enthusiasm for innovation drives you to explore new ideas, challenge the status quo, and find creative solutions that deliver meaningful impact. You approach your work with energy and a desire to advance both technology and the way we work.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Aligned with experience and market standards
  • Mediclaim: 10 Lacs coverage for you and your family
  • Flexible PTO Hybrid Work: Take time off when needed and enjoy remote flexibility per company guidelines
  • Growth Development: Access professional learning opportunities and career advancement support
  • Onsite Perks: Enjoy catered lunches, snacks
  • Team Bonding: Company-sponsored social events to connect and unwind

jobDescription:
Core AI Engineer Specialist

Experience: 7+ years

Location: Remote


Role Overview:

Experience req can be 7+ years with hands-on work in the pre-transformer era - people who have built models from scratch before 2017 and not just fine-tuned existing models. Good understanding of classical ML/DL algorithms and maths behind it.


We value what you have built over where you studied. A GitHub history, a Kaggle record, merged pull requests to a training library, a paper you reimplemented and evaluated properly all of these count for more with us than the name on your degree. If your CV is thin and your repositories are not, apply anyway. We read the repositories first.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Build models from scratch architectures, training loops, custom losses, data pipelines in PyTorch , not in a wrapper.
  • Post-train language models: supervised fine-tuning, knowledge distillation under a real capacity gap, PEFT, and RL from preferences or verifiable rewards.
  • Implement papers end to end, from an arXiv PDF to working code, and evaluate them rigorously enough that we can act on the result including when it is negative.
  • Adapt general models to specific domains without destroying what they already knew.
  • Cut GPU cost parallelism placement, memory, quantisation, serving-time arithmetic and measure the saving rather than asserting it.
  • Track the field and adopt what is worth adopting, quickly, and tell us what is not.

What we require:

  • Deep learning fundamentals. Backpropagation, optimisation and transformer architectures attention, tokenisation, embeddings understood mechanically, not as vocabulary. You should be able to explain why attention is scaled by 1/d, what a normalisation layer does to gradient flow, and what actually happens in an optimiser step.
  • Hands-on PyTorch or Keras. You build and train models from scratch — not fine-tuning through an API, not Trainer with a config file.
  • LLM post-training, in practice — SFT (data construction, packing, masking, and what goes wrong); knowledge distillation (forward vs reverse KL, on-policy distillation, capacity gaps); PEFT ( LoRA and QLoRA , quantisation, adapter placement and rank selection); RLHF and its descendants — DPO, GRPO, PPO, RLOO : what each optimises and how each fails.
  • Engineering. Solid Python . CUDA and GPU-training basics — what is actually running on the device, and why your step time is what it is. Distributed training (DDP / FSDP) is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Proven ability to implement papers end to end — arXiv to working code — and to evaluate rigorously. Rigorous means seeds, baselines, controls and an honest statement of the noise floor.
  • Speed of adoption. This field moves faster than any curriculum. We need people who read, try, discard and keep the residue — and who can tell the difference between a real advance and a well-marketed one.

Mandatory Tech Stack:

  • Languages: Python, C++, CUDA
  • Deep Learning: PyTorch, NumPy, SciPy
  • LLM / Transformers: Hugging Face Transformers, TRL, Tokenizers
  • Fine-tuning & Post-training: PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, DPO, GRPO, PPO, RLOO, Knowledge Distillation
  • Training: DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, Mixed Precision, Gradient Checkpointing
  • GPU & Performance: CUDA, NVIDIA GPUs, GPU Profiling, Quantisation, Memory & Compute Optimisation
  • Inference & Serving: vLLM, TensorRT-LLM
  • Data & Experimentation: Hugging Face Datasets, Pandas, Weights & Biases / MLflow
  • Engineering: Linux, Git, GitHub, Docker

Core stack: Python + PyTorch + CUDA + Transformers/TRL + PEFT + LLM Post-training + Distributed Training + GPU Optimisation + vLLM.

jobDescription:
Hello, We are Hiring Partnership Manager API & Strategic Partnerships at Link Publishers Pvt. Ltd

Experience: 3 5 Years
Department: Sales & Partnerships
Location: Ahmedabad
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a Partnership Manager API & Strategic Partnerships who can identify and build partnerships with SEO products, SaaS platforms, agencies, and other digital marketing businesses.

The primary responsibility of this role is to identify companies where the Link Publishers API can be integrated into their existing product or where our platform can be offered as a white-label link-building solution under the partners own brand.

This is not a traditional sales role focused on mass cold outreach. We are looking for someone who can research a product, understand how it works, identify where Link Publishers fits into its ecosystem, and then approach the right decision-maker with a personalized partnership proposition.

Key Responsibilities 1. Identify API Partnership Opportunities

Research and identify SEO tools, SaaS products, marketing platforms, backlink tools, content platforms, AI SEO tools, agency software, and other relevant products where the Link Publishers API can add value.

You will be expected to:

1/ Understand what the target product does and who its customers are.
2/ Explore the product, website, features, pricing, and existing integrations.
3/ Identify where link-building capabilities can fit naturally into the product.
4/ Develop a clear use case for integrating the Link Publishers API.
5/ Identify the right companies based on partnership potential rather than simply building large prospect lists.

For example, if an SEO platform helps users identify backlink opportunities but doesnt provide a way to actually purchase or execute those placements, you should be able to identify how Link Publishers can potentially fill that gap through an API integration.

2. Build White-Label Partnerships

Identify companies that want to offer link-building services to their customers without building their own publisher network or fulfillment infrastructure.

The goal is to position Link Publishers as their backend link-building partner while they continue selling the service under their own brand name.

Potential partners may include:

1/ SEO agencies
2/ Digital marketing agencies
3/ SaaS companies
4/ SEO platforms
5/ Content marketing platforms
6/ Reseller businesses
7/ Enterprise SEO service providers

You will understand their existing business model and propose a white-label partnership that makes commercial sense for both companies.

3. CXO & Decision-Maker Outreach

Identify and connect with relevant decision-makers, including:

Founders, Co-Founders, CEOs, CMOs, Heads of SEO, Heads of Partnerships, Product Heads, Business Heads, and other senior stakeholders.

The role requires thoughtful outreach rather than sending generic templates.

Before contacting a prospect, you should understand:

What does their company do Where can Link Publishers fit What value can we add Who is the right person to approach What should the partnership proposal look like

4. Personalized Email Outreach

Strong email writing is one of the most important requirements for this position.

You should be able to research a product and write a personalized email explaining exactly how an API integration or white-label partnership could benefit their business.

We are not looking for generic emails such as:

"We provide link-building services and would love to explore a partnership."

Instead, outreach should demonstrate that you have understood the prospects product and identified a genuine integration opportunity.

Emails should be concise, personalized, commercially relevant, and written to generate conversations with senior decision-makers.

5. Partnership Discussions & Closure

Once a prospect shows interest, you will own the partnership conversation from initial discussion to closure.

This includes:

1/ Understanding the partners requirements
2/ Conducting discovery calls
3/ Presenting relevant API/white-label solutions
4/ Coordinating product demonstrations
5/ Discussing commercial models
6/ Coordinating technical discussions with internal teams
7/ Following up with stakeholders
8/ Managing NDA/documentation requirements
9/ Moving opportunities toward integration and launch

You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable understanding how APIs work from a business and product perspective.

What Were Looking For

Experience: 3 5 years in Partnerships, Business Development, SaaS Sales, Strategic Alliances, API Partnerships, SEO SaaS, or a similar role.

The ideal candidate should have:

1/ Strong understanding of SaaS products and online business models.
2/ Good understanding of SEO and link building.
3/ Ability to research and understand new products independently.
4/ Ability to identify API integration opportunities.
5/ Experience communicating with founders and CXO-level stakeholders.
6/ Excellent written English and email communication.
7/ Strong personalization and cold outreach skills.
8/ Ability to convert product research into a compelling partnership proposition.
9/ Confidence conducting discovery and partnership calls.
10/ Strong follow-up and relationship-management skills.
11/ Commercial mindset and ability to think beyond traditional sales.

Technical Understanding

You do not need to code for this role.

However, you should understand basic concepts such as:

API integrations, SaaS platforms, data exchange, product integrations, white-label solutions, marketplaces, and reseller models.

You should be able to communicate a potential integration use case clearly enough for product and technical teams to take the discussion forward.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured simply by the number of emails sent.

We will primarily look at the quality and business impact of partnerships generated, including:

Relevant companies identified Decision-makers contacted Qualified partnership conversations API/White-label opportunities Commercial discussions Signed partnerships Successful integrations

The objective is to build long-term distribution and technology partnerships that allow Link Publishers inventory and link-building capabilities to reach customers through other products and brands.

About Link Publishers

Link Publishers is a link-building marketplace that connects businesses, agencies, and SEO professionals with publishers across multiple industries and markets.

Through our API and white-label solutions, partners can integrate link-building capabilities into their own products or offer link-building services under their own brand while Link Publishers supports the inventory and fulfillment from the backend.

We are looking for someone who can identify where these partnerships make sense and turn those opportunities into scalable business relationships.

Job Summary

Position Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled QA Tester with deep experience in data warehouse testing, ETL validation, and BI reporting within the insurance industry. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical abilities, excellent SQL skills, and a proven track record of ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and completeness across complex data ecosystems. This role involves collaborating in cross-functional teams, contributing to the testing maturity, and driving continuous improvement in the testing process. They will be hands-on with test planning, execution, and automation, working closely with other testers in their area, both internal and third party, to cover a range of test types both functional and non-functional.   • Validate complex business rules, mappings, and transformation logic.
  • Test data across star schema, snowflake, fact, and dimension tables.

  • Create test plans, test cases, mapping sheets, data validation scripts, and defect logs.
  • Support Agile/Scrum processes and CI/CD testing workflows.
  • Identify, document, and track data quality issues through resolution.
  • Track and report meaningful QA metrics such as defect rates, test coverage, and automation effectiveness.
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging tools, and QA best practices.

title: AI Solutions Analyst
jobDescription:
AI Solutions Analyst

Mumbai Office


About the job

At Nouryon, our global team of changemakers takes positive action every day, to reach higher goals collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society's needs today and in the future.

The AI Solutions Analyst is a developer on Nouryon's AI invoice intelligence platform an application that reads supplier invoices and extracts charge-level detail to give the business full transparency into logistics cost. This role owns the end-to-end onboarding of vendors onto the platform analysing each vendor's invoice format, engineering the AI instructions that teach the system to read it correctly, and validating extraction quality until it can be trusted. This role is the connective tissue between the digital transformation team, logistics and procurement stakeholders, and the data that drives cost-leakage decisions — ensuring that AI-extracted invoice data translates into measurable savings, organisational transparency, and continuous improvement.


Job Description

The role is centered around the following core pillars:

  • AI Prompt Engineering – Design, tune and test the natural-language instructions that teach the AI to read each vendor's invoice format accurately.
  • Vendor Onboarding – Own the end-to-end onboarding of new vendors onto the platform, from first sample invoice to live, validated extraction.
  • Data Analytics – Serve as the analytical engine of the team by measuring extraction accuracy, error patterns, and AI processing cost, and translating findings into targeted improvements.
  • Data Quality Assurance – Validate AI output against source documents and safeguard the integrity of the invoice data reaching the business.
  • Stakeholder Management – Coordinate with the digital transformation team, logistics procurement, operations, and vendors to align formats, priorities and expectations.
  • Process Improvements – Identify and deploy improvements in onboarding, extraction, and quality-assurance workflows.

Job Responsibilities

Vendor Onboarding & Format Analysis

  • Collect and analyse representative sample invoices from new vendors across warehouse, ocean freight, road/rail, and customs brokerage modes.
  • Identify each vendor's invoice structure, charge-line conventions, and formatting quirks that affect automated extraction.
  • Onboard vendors onto the platform, configuring extraction profiles and routing settings per vendor.
  • Own a named portfolio of vendors end-to-end, from onboarding through to sustained extraction quality.

AI Prompt Engineering & Model Training

  • Design, write and iterate custom extraction prompts that teach the AI to read each vendor's invoices correctly.
  • Test prompt changes against curated reference sets before releasing them to production.
  • Diagnose extraction failures to root cause and resolve them at the prompt level, permanently rather than case by case.
  • Continuously improve extraction accuracy and reduce AI processing cost per invoice.

Validation & Data Quality

  • Validate AI-extracted charge lines, invoice metadata and classifications against source documents until extraction holds reliably.
  • Approve, correct or reject extracted data, ensuring only verified information reaches downstream reporting.
  • Curate golden test sets from verified invoices to support regression testing.
  • Safeguard data quality, completeness and consistency across the vendor portfolio.

Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Measure and report extraction accuracy, first-pass approval rate, and AI cost per invoice for owned vendors.
  • Analyse error patterns across vendors, modes and document types to identify systemic improvement opportunities.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for the programme team and senior stakeholders.
  • Prepare periodic performance reporting for leadership.

Stakeholder Engagement & Process Improvement

  • Act as a key interface between the digital transformation team, logistics procurement, operations, and vendors on onboarding and extraction topics.
  • Escalate invoice formats or system limitations that require platform-level changes, with a recommended course of action.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across onboarding, prompt engineering, and quality-assurance workflows.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of analytics, reporting, and decision-support tooling.

We believe you bring (Education & Experience)

This is a specific profile. We are not looking for a generalist analyst — we are looking for someone who has built AI solutions in the field, against real data, with users watching.

1. Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) experience
You have worked embedded with a business function, not behind a ticket queue. You have taken an ambiguous operational problem, built a working solution against real data, and iterated it in front of the people who use it. You are comfortable when requirements arrive as a conversation rather than a specification.

2. Prompting
You have built something with an LLM that worked measurably better on Friday than it did on Monday — and you can explain exactly why. You treat prompts as engineered artefacts: versioned, tested against a reference set, and improved against a number. Experience with structured extraction from documents is a strong advantage.

3. Scrum
You have delivered in sprints — planning, stand-up, demo, retro — in a self-organising team. This team has no team lead: you will pick up work from a prioritised backlog, commit to it, and be accountable for it without being assigned it.

4. SQL and Python (pandas)
Intermediate SQL: joins, aggregations, grouping, window functions. Python at pandas level, sufficient to analyse extraction results offline, compare model outputs across runs, and quantify accuracy. You use data to prove an improvement, not to describe it.

5. Structured problem decomposition
You turn "this vendor extracts badly" into a specific, testable hypothesis, a defined check, and a fix that holds. You look for the systematic cause behind a single error rather than correcting the symptom.

6. Analytical rigour on documents
You can find one wrong figure in a forty-line charge table — and you are still finding it at four in the afternoon. Sustained precision over high volumes of detailed document work is the daily craft of this role.


Nice to have

  • Domain exposure — finance, procurement, logistics or supply chain; invoices, freight, warehousing, customs (Invoice processing, Accounts Payable)
  • Data annotation, labelling or data-quality operations background
  • Palantir Foundry experience
  • Statistical or ML modelling depth beyond descriptive analytics
  • BI tooling — Power BI, Tableau
  • Scrum certification — CSM / PSM
  • Version control — Git fundamentals
  • Experience supporting European stakeholders from an offshore or captive centre

Education & Experience

  • 2 to 8 years of relevant experience in forward deployed engineering, solution delivery, data analytics, or technical consulting.
  • Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Supply Chain, Operations Research, or a related field from an accredited institution.

jobDescription:
We invite you to come grow with us.

Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, bringing together connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion and precision, we connect insight, strategy and execution to help clients make stronger decisions, accelerate performance and deliver lasting impact for patients. Data, technology and AI enhance this work, alongside the human expertise and judgement that define our advisory offer.

About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignites global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Design and redesign slides, proposal sections, RFP materials, credentials and case studies to improve clarity, visual hierarchy, structure and readability.
  • Apply Inizio Ignite brand standards, PowerPoint templates, visual systems and document standards consistently.
  • Translate clear briefs and developed content into polished visual outputs, escalating gaps or ambiguity early.
  • Adapt existing materials for different audiences, clients, geographies and pursuit contexts.
  • Create reusable slides, diagrams, icons and data visuals.
  • Work with the design team and the Senior Designer on more complex visual storytelling and priority pursuits.
  • Own the quality of your work, complete the studio self-check and resolve issues identified through design review or independent QA.
  • Maintain clean, editable, accessible, well-named and version-controlled files that are ready for handover and reuse.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly where they improve understanding, exploration or efficiency, while applying independent design judgement to every output.
  • Contribute to asset tagging, template improvement, knowledge capture and shared ways of working.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • Around 2-4 years of experience in presentation design, graphic design, visual design or a similar role, ideally supporting proposals, pitches, RFPs or other client-facing materials.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong layout, visual hierarchy, slide design, brand application and the ability to make complex content easier to understand.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills and working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or comparable design tools; Think-cell or other charting experience would be useful.
  • Good understanding of typography, templates, design systems, iconography, data visualisation and document polish.
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to ask focused questions when briefs, priorities or source content are incomplete.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to manage several workstreams within agreed service levels.
  • Practical AI literacy and the judgement to review, refine or reject AI-assisted suggestions before use.
  • Experience with healthcare, life sciences, consulting or professional-services content would be advantageous.

Ideal profile

  • You enjoy turning rough or inconsistent content into clear, polished and client-ready materials.
  • You can work confidently within templates while bringing creativity, clarity and visual thinking.
  • You seek feedback, learn quickly and take increasing ownership as your skills develop.
  • You are collaborative, dependable and motivated to help build a new global design capability.

Career progression

This role sits within the Design Studio career framework of Production QA Assistant, a Design team and Senior Designer. Progression to the next level is based on stronger independent ownership, visual storytelling, stakeholder management, delivery of more complex work and contribution to studio standards - not tenure alone.

Life at Inizio Ignite

You will join a connected, global business where collaboration, curiosity, drive and agility shape how we work. We encourage people to bring their authentic selves, keep learning, challenge the status quo and do the right thing.

In the Design Studio, you will have the opportunity to help build a new capability, work with international teams and influence how Ignite presents its expertise to clients.

We provide

  • A learning culture with opportunities to develop design, technology, AI and healthcare knowledge.
  • International collaboration across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and wider Inizio teams.
  • A supportive, inclusive and friendly working environment where your contribution matters.
  • A visible career framework, supported by regular feedback, skills development and opportunities to take on greater complexity and responsibility.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

title: Designer
tagsAndSkills: adobe creative cloud,client delivery,ai,concurrent,craft,business development,case studies,iconography
jobDescription:
About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignites global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Own the design and delivery of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority client-facing materials.
  • Translate strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear visual narratives, page structures, diagrams and data stories.
  • Develop credible visual options based on the audience, content maturity, client context and available time.
  • Manage multiple assignments independently, clarify briefs with business stakeholders and flag scope, timing or quality risks early.
  • Apply and reinforce Inizio Ignite brand standards, templates, accessibility requirements and final-file standards.
  • Provide constructive craft feedback and practical support to Designer 1 colleagues, while escalating priority creative decisions to the Senior Designer.
  • Own the quality of your work, complete the studio self-check and resolve issues identified through creative review or independent QA.
  • Create and refine reusable templates, slide components, visual systems, iconography and data-visualisation patterns.
  • Maintain clean, editable, accessible, correctly named and version-controlled files that support reliable handover and future reuse.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate understanding, exploration and production, while ensuring every output is accurate, appropriate and human-reviewed.
  • Contribute to studio standards, onboarding materials, knowledge capture and continuous improvement.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • Around 4+ years of experience in presentation design, visual design, production design or a related creative role, ideally in healthcare, life sciences, consulting, professional services or an agency environment.
  • A strong portfolio showing polished client-facing presentation work, visual storytelling, slide redesign, data visualisation and alternative creative approaches.
  • Advanced PowerPoint skills and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or similar tools; charting experience would be advantageous.
  • Strong command of layout, typography, hierarchy, information design, brand application and final-file quality.
  • Ability to work directly with stakeholders, challenge unclear briefs constructively and manage expectations across several concurrent requests.
  • Experience giving useful craft feedback or supporting the development of less-experienced designers.
  • Practical AI literacy and the judgement to evaluate AI-assisted outputs critically and responsibly.
  • High attention to detail, strong prioritisation and confidence working under time pressure without compromising core quality standards.
  • Ideal profile
  • You can move comfortably between fast-turn production work and more considered visual storytelling.
  • You take ownership, communicate clearly and know when to involve the Senior Designer or business stakeholder.
  • You enjoy helping others improve and contributing to shared standards, assets and ways of working.
  • You are motivated by the opportunity to shape a new Design Studio and strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise.

Ideal profile

  • You enjoy turning rough or inconsistent content into clear, polished and client-ready materials.
  • You can work confidently within templates while bringing creativity, clarity and visual thinking.
  • You seek feedback, learn quickly and take increasing ownership as your skills develop.
  • You are collaborative, dependable and motivated to help build a new global design capability.

Career progression

This role sits within the Design Studio career framework of Production QA Assistant, a Design team and Senior Designer. Progression to the next level is based on stronger independent ownership, visual storytelling, stakeholder management, delivery of more complex work and contribution to studio standards - not tenure alone.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

jobDescription:

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.

  • Extreme Ownership: We don t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

  • The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time.

  • Methodology & Rigor: We don t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.

  • Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.

  • The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.

  • Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.

  • Unlimited Leaves: We don t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.

  • Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.


As a Staff Engineer Network Security & Attack Path Intelligence, you will define and lead the technical direction of Safe s network reachability and attack-path intelligence capabilities across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

You will be the hands-on architect behind systems that connect network topology, identities, vulnerabilities, security controls, and business-critical assets to determine how attackers can move through an enterprise environment.

You ll collaborate with product, backend, graph, data, AI, and platform teams to build scalable, explainable, and enterprise-ready attack-path capabilities.

This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role. You will architect systems, build prototypes, write production-quality code, and help shape how Safe s CTEM platform identifies and breaks the attack paths that pose the greatest business risk.

Core Responsibilities:
  • Architect Safe s Attack Path Intelligence: Define the architecture and data model for network topology, effective reachability, trust boundaries, identities, vulnerabilities, controls, and attack paths across complex enterprise environments.
  • Build Core Attack Path Capabilities: Write production-quality code for network configuration parsing, reachability analysis, attack-graph construction, graph traversal, exposure chaining, and blast-radius computation. Build prototypes and evolve them into reliable, enterprise-scale services.
  • Model Effective Network Reachability: Derive actual connectivity from routing tables, VLANs, ACLs, firewalls, NAT, VPNs, proxies, load balancers, and segmentation policies rather than relying only on documented topology.
  • Model Attacker Movement: Build reasoning systems that connect exposed services, vulnerabilities, credentials, Active Directory privileges, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and access to critical assets.
  • Prioritize Actionable Attack Paths: Distinguish theoretical paths from reachable, exploitable, and business-critical attack paths. Incorporate exploitability, control effectiveness, asset criticality, and business impact into prioritization.
  • Enterprise Security Integrations: Design integrations with firewalls, routers, NAC, EDR, CMDB, Active Directory, vulnerability scanners, NetFlow, cloud platforms, and other enterprise security systems.
  • Countermeasure Intelligence: Build a vendor-neutral model for recommending segmentation, isolation, firewall-policy changes, access-control improvements, and compensating controls. Define validation, approval, safety, and rollback requirements.
  • AI and Graph Integration: Partner with other engineers to ensure attack-path explanations and countermeasure recommendations are evidence-backed, explainable, technically accurate, and governed through deterministic safety policies.
  • Validation & Governance: Build reference attack scenarios, simulation environments, regression datasets, and validation frameworks to verify attack paths and proposed countermeasures without introducing unacceptable operational risk.
  • Mentor & Multiply: Guide backend, graph, security, and platform engineers through architectural design, code reviews, prototypes, engineering standards, and complex security-domain decisions.
Minimum Qualifications:

Experience: 12+ years of experience in software engineering, network security, security product engineering, exposure management, or related areas, with a strong record of building and shipping production systems.

Core Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, Go, Java, or a similar backend language
  • Recent experience writing and shipping production-quality software not only providing architectural or advisory guidance
  • Strong system-design, API-design, data-modeling, and distributed-systems fundamentals
  • Experience implementing graph traversal, rule-processing, network automation, configuration analysis, or security analytics
  • Ability to independently prototype complex ideas and evolve them into scalable production capabilities
  • Familiarity with graph databases and graph-processing technologies

Network Security

  • Deep understanding of enterprise on-premises, cloud, and hybrid networks
  • Strong knowledge of routing, switching, VLANs, ACLs, firewalls, NAT, VPNs, proxies, load balancers, and network segmentation
  • Experience deriving effective reachability across complex network configurations
  • Understanding of firewall-policy analysis, change validation, control effectiveness, and security misconfiguration detection

Attack Path & Identity Security

  • Strong understanding of Active Directory, Kerberos, identity privilege paths, credential exposure, privilege escalation, and lateral movement
  • Experience with attack graphs, attack-path analysis, threat modelling, breach simulation, or exposure chaining
  • Ability to connect vulnerabilities and misconfigurations with network reachability and attacker behaviour
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and common enterprise attack techniques

Product Engineering: Experience translating deep security-domain knowledge into scalable products, analytical systems, or security-platform capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience building attack-path, network digital-twin, microsegmentation, or CTEM products
  • Experience with graph databases and large-scale graph computation
  • Experience with BloodHound, Nmap, Zeek, Wireshark, NetFlow, or similar technologies
  • Experience with Forward Networks, XM Cyber, RedSeal, AlgoSec, Tufin, FireMon, or comparable platforms
  • Experience with Palo Alto Networks, Cisco, Fortinet, Check Point, Juniper, or other enterprise network-control technologies
  • Exposure to Pentera, AttackIQ, Picus, Horizon3.ai, or other security-validation platforms
  • Background spanning both offensive and defensive security
  • Experience safely validating security controls in production-like environments
  • Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP networking
  • Experience working with large, complex, and highly regulated enterprises
  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, CISSP, CCIE Security, CCNP Security, or GIAC
  • Published research, patents, open-source contributions, or previous technical leadership in security-product engineering is a strong plus

title: Sr. Business Development Representative
jobDescription:
About the Role

As a Senior Business Development Representative, you will play a pivotal role at the front of the sales function by building a high-quality pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting. Working closely with UK-based Account Executives, you will identify, engage and qualify prospective customers, ensuring opportunities are effectively handed over for continued progression.

This is a high-activity role focused on personalised outreach, pipeline generation and maintaining excellent data quality. You will collaborate on account strategy and messaging, continuously refine outbound approaches, and contribute directly to the growth of the business through consistent execution and strong commercial awareness.

  • Continuously test and optimise outbound messaging and sequences to improve reply rates and conversion performance.

Requirements

  • Industry experience would be a great advantage, with a background in staff augmentation / tech talent as a service, and an understanding of the model, the buyer and the objections.
  • Alternatively, strong experience in tech recruitment and staffing outbound or SDR, with the ability to open a retained, long-term relationship rather than a one-off placement.
  • Alternatively, B2B SaaS or technology SDR/BDR experience selling to CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior technical buyers.
  • An experienced outbound prospector, ideally LinkedIn-led, within B2B technology or talent.
  • Comfortable prospecting into CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior technical buyers.
  • An excellent written communicator in English, with a natural, human outbound style, not "spray and pray".
  • Highly organised and able to manage high volume without dropping quality.
  • Familiar with MEDDPICC qualification principles.
  • Self-starting, resilient and target-driven, with the ability to work UK hours alongside a UK-based team.

Benefits

  • Uncapped commission and a clear path to promotions.
  • Fully remote within India, working closely with a London-based team.
  • Generous holiday leave
  • The chance to build your sales career inside a scaling business with global ambition.

title: Senior AI & Data Engineer
jobDescription:
Senior AI & Data Engineer
This role has been designed as Onsite with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
Role Summary
The Senior AI & Data Engineer is an individual contributor role that acts as the technical subject matter expert at the intersection of AI engineering and data engineering. This is a uniquely dual-domain role: the successful candidate bridges the organization s data strategy with its AI agenda, ensuring that intelligent systems are built on a foundation of governed, high-quality, well-architected data.
On the AI side, this role designs and delivers end-to-end production-grade AI products architecting multi-agent frameworks, fine-tuning and evaluating LLMs, building robust ML pipelines, and ensuring AI solutions are scalable, explainable, and responsibly governed. On the data side, this role defines the data architecture, transformation standards, and quality frameworks that make those AI products possible owning the data platform across Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Collibra.
Beyond individual delivery, this role provides technical leadership across cross-functional initiatives, defines engineering standards for both AI and data engineering practice, and leads the Applied AI Engineer and AI Data Engineer. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise across the full stack: from classical machine learning and modern generative AI through to data architecture, governance, and pipeline engineering with the communication skills to translate that expertise into measurable business impact.
What youll do:
Technical Leadership & Subject Matter Expertise
  • Serve as the dual AI & data SME for the team and organization the escalation point for complex technical decisions spanning model design, data architecture, pipeline engineering, and deployment.
  • Define and uphold engineering standards, design patterns, and best practices across both AI and data engineering disciplines; conduct architecture reviews and provide technical sign-off on all major deliverables.
  • Lead technical discovery for new AI and data use cases: evaluate feasibility, recommend solution approaches, and produce architecture documents for stakeholder alignment.
  • Participate in and lead cross-functional initiatives where AI and data strategy intersect partnering with product, business, and platform teams to translate strategy into shipped solutions.
  • Mentor and upskill the Applied AI Engineer and AI Data Engineer through pair programming, code reviews, design sessions, and structured knowledge transfer.
Advanced LLM Engineering & Agentic AI
  • Architect and deliver complex agentic AI systems multi-agent pipelines, tool-use frameworks, autonomous task orchestration
  • Design and implement advanced RAG architectures including hybrid search, re-ranking, query decomposition, and self-reflective retrieval patterns
  • Lead LLM evaluation frameworks: define metrics, build automated eval harnesses, and benchmark Claude, GPT, and Copilot performance against business KPIs
  • Assess and implement LLM fine-tuning and alignment strategies where pre-trained models do not meet requirements
  • Own LLM integration architecture API design, latency optimization, token cost management, rate limit handling, and fallback strategies
Machine Learning & Data Science
  • Lead the full ML lifecycle: problem framing, data strategy, feature engineering, model selection, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Develop advanced ML solutions across NLP, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, recommendation, and classification/regression domains.
  • Design and implement MLOps pipelines for automated model training, versioning, A/B testing, and drift detection in production environments.
  • Apply statistical rigour hypothesis testing, causal inference, experimental design to validate model outcomes and business impact.
  • Ensure explainability (SHAP, LIME, attention visualization) and fairness assessments are embedded in all production models.

title: System Analyst
jobDescription:
Job Summary
Bajaj Finserv Web is a critical component of the company's omnipresence strategy. You will be working with India's largest NBFC's web technology stack, encompassing over 40 business lines and 230+ features, with nearly 500 million traffic and managing over 30,000 webpages. It is an integrated platform offering a portfolio of products covering payments, cards, wallets, loans, deposits, mutual funds, and loans on lifestyle products, ranging from consumer durables to home furnishings. The Software Development Manager (SDM) - Full Stack leads a single POD of 5-7 developers building the experience and services layer of this platform on Next.js, React and Node JS. Reporting to the Technical Architect - Frontend, the role converts approved architecture and design system standards into production-grade full stack implementations - server rendered and statically generated pages, shared components, BFF and API integration layers - and is accountable for the POD's delivery predictability, Core Web Vitals, code quality and compliance posture. The role is expected to remain hands-on, conduct code reviews, enforce engineering standards and SOPs, and continuously raise the productivity of the POD through automation and AI-assisted engineering.
Responsibilities
  • Data Privacy and Security: Ensure all development within the POD complies with applicable data privacy regulation, RBI and internal information security policy, including data localisation requirements for any cloud or AI service used.
  • Secure SDLC: Enforce secure coding practices covering the OWASP Top 10, dependency and supply chain scanning, secrets management, and timely closure of VAPT and application security findings.
  • Browser and Client Security: Ensure correct implementation of CSP, XSS and CSRF protection, secure token and session handling in the browser, and governance of third-party scripts and tags on the POD's surfaces.
  • Audit Readiness: Maintain traceability from requirement to code to release - approvals, change records, test evidence and deployment records - so that internal audit and regulatory reviews can be served without rework.
  • Incident Management: Own the POD's participation in production incident response, root cause analysis and preventive action tracking, ensuring minimal customer impact.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Execute POCs to validate frameworks, rendering approaches and migration paths with clear benchmarking on performance, cost and scalability before adoption.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Drive adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering within the POD - code generation, review assistance, test generation and design-to-code workflows - with measurable impact on velocity and quality and with clear guardrails on data, IP and security.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Support the migration of the existing CMS rendered estate to a composable Next.js frontend for the POD's scope, ensuring zero regression on organic traffic, analytics and compliance sensitive journeys.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Leverage and sponsor innovation work through internal incubators and the external start-up network to introduce novel technical capabilities into the platform.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Maintain a technical debt and dependency upgrade register for the POD's codebase with an agreed remediation plan, including supply chain risk across the dependency tree.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Establish frontend observability for the POD - real user monitoring, synthetic checks and error tracking through New Relic, Datadog and Lighthouse CI - and act on the telemetry.
  • POD and Team Management: Technical Mentorship: Provide day to day technical guidance to 5-7 developers, run design and code walkthroughs, and build depth in the POD through structured learning paths and pair programming.
  • POD and Team Management: Performance Management: Set clear, measurable goals for every team member, conduct regular one-on-ones and reviews, give constructive feedback, and close the appraisal cycle within timelines.
  • POD and Team Management: Capacity and Resource Planning: Allocate work across the POD based on story complexity, skill fit and individual development needs, maintain sprint velocity and utilisation, and flag capacity risks to the Technical Architect early.
  • POD and Team Management: Talent Acquisition and Retention: Participate in hiring panels, own the technical evaluation of candidates for the POD, and run structured onboarding and ramp-up plans for new joiners, byte hires and partner resources.
  • POD and Team Management: Partner Management: Manage in-POD vendor and partner developers to the same standard of quality, hygiene and delivery discipline as internal engineers.
  • POD and Team Management: Team Collaboration: Build a cohesive POD with strong communication into Product, Design, Content, QA and infrastructure teams, and maintain high engagement and morale.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own end-to-end delivery for the POD - sprint planning, estimation, build, code review, testing, release and post-release stabilisation - for all web and in-app surfaces in scope.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Translate the solution design provided by the Technical Architect into implementable low-level designs, component specifications, API and data contracts, and task breakdowns for the POD.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Remain hands-on for a meaningful share of the role (target 30-40%) on Next.js and React development with TypeScript, including App Router, React Server Components, SSR, SSG, ISR and streaming.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own the POD's Node JS services and BFF layer - route handlers, API aggregation, GraphQL and REST consumption, caching, resilience patterns, timeouts and error handling.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Consume and contribute to the enterprise design system and shared component library, ensuring token, theming, versioning and Storybook discipline rather than local forks and one-off components.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Implement integration with headless content sources (AEM headless or other CMS/DXP), commerce and backend services through the contract layer defined by the Architect.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own state management, data fetching and form and validation architecture within the POD's applications, keeping patterns consistent with the platform standard.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own edge and caching behaviour for the POD's routes in partnership with CDN teams - cache key design, revalidation, purge strategy and origin protection across Akamai and Cloudflare.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Drive release readiness through build checklists, feature flag and progressive rollout plans, deployment runbooks, rollback plans and production hypercare for every deployment.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Ensure the POD's digital assets continue to perform through peak sales season by designing for auto-scale, graceful degradation and resilient rendering across the Node / SSR tier, CDN and origin.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Define and enforce coding standards, branching strategy, peer review, merge and promotion discipline across the POD using Git, GitHub Actions or Jenkins, and monorepo and package governance conventions.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Own quality gates - SonarQube, static analysis, code coverage, bundle size checks, Lighthouse CI budgets and automated security scanning - and hold the line on defect density and escaped defects.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Own the POD's Core Web Vitals outcomes (LCP, INP, CLS) including bundle analysis and code splitting, image and font strategy, hydration cost, streaming and partial prerendering, with explicit optimisation for low-end Android devices, low bandwidth networks and in-app webviews.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Ensure testing coverage across unit, component, contract and end-to-end layers using Jest, Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress, along with visual regression, before any release is certified.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Own SEO, GEO, structured data, render parity and accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) as build-time concerns for the POD rather than post-release corrections.
Key Decisions / Dimensions
  • Following decisions are taken by the role:
  • Low-level design and component design decisions within the boundaries of the architecture and design system standards approved by the Technical Architect.
  • Rendering mode selection per route - SSR, SSG, ISR or client rendering - within the strategy defined by the Architect.
  • Implementation approach for BFF and API integration, state management, error handling and resilience patterns for the POD's scope.
  • Sprint scope, story sequencing, estimation and allocation of work across the 5-7 developers in the POD

This role will power next-generation decisioning across lending lifecycle- understanding lifecycle- underwriting, portfolio monitoring, fraud controls, early warning, allocation strategy optimization, and recovery uplift ?? by delivering production-grade ML systems with measurable impact. (Training + fine-tuning + serving) under BFSI governance, security, and model risk constraints.

Duties and Responsibilities


Own the AI Pod operating model across Credit Risk, Fraud/FRM, and collections/Recovery: outcomes,

roadmap, delivery cadence, and cross-team dependencies.


Lead end-to-end model lifecycle: problem framing, feature strategy, training, evaluation, development,

monitoring, and continuous improvement with clear scorecards per use-case.


Build large-scale ML systems: distributed training pipelines, feature stores, model registry, CI/CD for ML, and

scalable batch + near-real-time scoring services.


Deliver Credit & Risk models: application/behavior risk models, limit assignment, early warning signals,

portfolio monitoring, and policy optimization.


Deliver Frau & FRM systems: fraud propensity/risk scoring, anomaly detection, identity/device/channel

signals using Graph Machine Learning.


Deliver collection & recovery optimization: roll-rate/cure/flow models, contactability, propensity-to-pay and

recovery forecasting.



Define operating models: SLIs/SLOs, incident response, and stakeholder cadence.


Hire, develop, and scale the team: drive standards for quality, safety, and reliability.

Required Qualifications and Experience


Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor??s/Master??s in CS/Math/Engineering (PhD preferred in Large scale Machine learning systems)

10+ years experience in Data Science /Applied ML/ ML Engineering with proven leadership delivering

production ?? grade ML system at scale.

Demonstrated success shipping models with measurable business impact in credit risk, fraud/FRM, and /or

collection & recovery.

ML evaluation rigor: calibration, stability/drift, bias/fairness checks, leakage prevention, robust back-testing, and champion-challenger frameworks. Production mindset: ability to translate business objectives into ML systems with strong monitoring, alerting, and operational playbooks. Distributed systems knowledge: scaling, caching, sharding, HA, performance tuning for both training and serving. Experience with common stacks: feature stores, model registry, experiment tracking, vector/graph where relevant, stream/batch processing Kubernetes, CI/CD. Observability: logging/metrics/tracing, incident management, SLO-driven operations. Experience with data and compute stacks: Spark, Kafka/streaming, Lakehouse/warehouse, APIs/microservices. Governance, Security, and Compliance Designing for BFSI constraints: PII handling, policy enforcement, auditability, access controls. Risk-aware engineering mindset: safe tool execution, approval workflows, and secure-by-design, approval workflows, and secure by design patterns. Leadership Behaviors High ownership, structured thinking, and ability to drive clarity in ambiguous environments. Strong program management

Close Personal Assistant
Job Description
At Impressico, the Personal Assistant to the Technical Director exists to protect the Director s time and attention so that it is spent on the highest-value technical and strategic work.   • Schedule meetings and working sessions across internal leadership, delivery teams, clients and vendors, including across time zones, and ensure invites, agendas, rooms and conferencing links are correct

  • Arrange all travel and logistics for the Director and, where required, family - air, rail and hotel bookings, visas, cabs, itineraries, expense claims and reimbursements - and re-plan quickly when arrangements change at short notice
  • Provide day-to-day office and personal support - meeting rooms and equipment, visitor hosting, meals and refreshments during long working days, courier and documentation errands, appointments, bill payments and similar personal chores as directed
  • Act as the first point of contact for the Director s office; screen and route incoming requests, and maintain professional working relationships with internal leaders, clients, vendors and service providers
  • Maintain the Director s records and trackers - initiative and action-item trackers, contacts, subscriptions, vendor documentation and confidential files - with accuracy and version discipline
